body:
This constructs the narrower gettenberg provider replacement approved in #528. It retains the catalog/resource infrastructure and migration-baseline parser, with the two source-corroborated terminal-notice repairs, explicit cleanup provenance, and necessary gather integration. The broader extraction/readiness/editorial-review runtime remains preserved on `codex/gettenberg-qualification` / #524. This draft targets `codex/gettenberg-acquisition`; it does not request main promotion.

**Correction: restore per-item cleanup refusal continuation as required replacement integration.** The broader product branch already caught `cleanup_refused` and continued. Constructing the narrow candidate removed that guarantee along with the editorial result system. Earlier explanations incorrectly framed continuation as merely an experimental convenience or optional enhancement. The user approved this correction.

The repaired batch records each cleanup refusal, leaves that input unpublished, and attempts subsequent inputs. Other operational failures still abort. A small ready/skipped/refused result reaches the CLI, which reports incomplete status 2 after the remaining selected collections run. `gather_stories()` retains its historical pair wrapper. Logging and atomic/no-overwrite publication remain; no cleanup, source selection, parser, normalization, or output-publisher changes. No editorial workflow is restored.

Actual frozen-cohort yield, using the configured-order intersection of 1,659 inputs:

| Invocation | Published | Reused | Refused | Unattempted |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Previous cold batch | 41 | 0 | 1 | 1,617 |
| Repaired cold batch | 1,646 | 0 | 13 | 0 |
| Repaired repeated batch | 0 | 1,646 | 13 | 0 |
| Separate one-item calls | 1,646 | 0 | 13 | 0 |
| Successful outputs with empty source cache | 0 | 1,646 | 0 | 0 |

All published body hashes, owner IDs and fixture-source hashes match the prior one-item census. Repetition preserves output bytes; the same 13 IDs remain refused. No other skips/errors, collisions or body mismatches. Replay took 421.820s against committed product `8c9441ddf707f4bdcd11afc4e9c4126d0976b8bc`. The measurement uses explicit fixture transport over historically decoded UTF-8, with real downstream product behavior and forbidden sockets. It does not establish historical HTTP fidelity, acquisition pacing, full 5,492-ID collection yield or editorial acceptance. No Gutenberg downloads or canonical corpus writes.

Earlier causal accounting remains valid and unchanged: all 67 body differences and 13 refusals have controlled observations. Differences group into 55 notice-only additions, nine richer suffixes, one newline-only change, one restored source prefix, and one frontmatter/tail interaction. Causes are not acceptance. Blindly restoring the legacy footer boundary would again lose ID 23552's 387-character final narrative paragraph; that independent extractor defect remains separate.

Validation for this correction:

- All four GitHub checks pass on head `823f33c23836aff220fab80046ab84b80584c063` (lint, both test jobs, coverage).
- Canonical `scripts/test`: **2,956 tests pass**; 46 targeted package tests and 26 experiment tests pass.
- Real fixture-backed coordinator tests cover success → refusal → success, incomplete status 2, repeated-run byte preservation, non-refusal decode abort after a written prefix, empty selection and ordinary skips.
- Package and explicit experiment Black/Ruff pass. LRH: zero errors, 351 existing warnings.
- Initial sandboxed full-suite invocation failed on loopback/fixture-write permissions; the authorized rerun passed. Both logs are archived.
- Coordinator cross-report checks verify every body/source/owner identity and refusal set. No new independent review or isolated-wheel qualification is claimed. Prior wheel evidence remains historical, not evidence for the changed runtime.

Evidence: [refusal continuation and batch yield](https://github.com/xenotaur/LCATS/blob/codex/gettenberg-narrow-delivery/experiments/10_gettenberg_qualification/results/gettenberg-refusal-continuation-20261023/README.md), [prior causal ledger](https://github.com/xenotaur/LCATS/blob/codex/gettenberg-narrow-delivery/experiments/10_gettenberg_qualification/results/gettenberg-causal-yield-20261023/README.md), [candidate scope and qualification](https://github.com/xenotaur/LCATS/blob/codex/gettenberg-narrow-delivery/lcats/project/development/gettenberg-narrow-delivery.md), and [runlog](https://github.com/xenotaur/LCATS/blob/codex/gettenberg-narrow-delivery/lcats/project/development/gettenberg-development-log.md). Historical results remain byte-identical; current evidence has a verified Git-tree checksum manifest.

**Still pending:** review/integration, the 13 unresolved refusals and body-contract dispositions, candidate evidence transfer, selection/wire boundaries, final Q1–Q8 acceptance mapping, and human main promotion. The measured fail-fast blocker is repaired for this frozen cohort; overall delivery acceptance is not claimed. Native execution records remain nonterminal.
title: Construct narrow gettenberg provider delivery candidate
